title: Inventory stock UI 10/10
summary: Inventory stock list shows readable names, dynamic category filters, search, reliable edit/restock actions, fixed CSV import/template, and removes the suppliers stub in favour of live synced panels.
highlights: Names like hoagie_roll display as Hoagie Roll (key kept as subtitle).
Category filter is built from your real stock categories (e.g. food), not a fixed veg/dairy list.
Search stock, set cost affordance when ₹0, supplier field on add/edit.
Import CSV prefers IngredientName; template matches import columns; POs include line items for receive.
Live Suppliers / POs / Waste from features-manage; no bogus 'configure via Growth Hub' stub.
